helpful: The provisioned petition.txt and questions-presented.txt were complete and legible; reading the petition directly was the single most useful input.
The sal-v4 band table with bracketed reached rates gave a clean arrival-population anchor once pooled over prior Terms.
CourtListener get_endpoint_item on the Federal Circuit opinion exposed the forfeiture holdings, which the petition does not mention and which drove the forecast.
gaps: fedcourts query has no originating-court or free-text filter, so pulling topical priors (e.g. prior CAFC government-contracts cert petitions) is not possible from the corpus.
The statpack does not cut grant or GVR rates by respondent class (SG respondent vs private), which is the one conditional I would most want for a government-respondent petition.
The SCOTUS docket was not yet on CourtListener a day after docketing, so post-docketing entries (a waiver) could not be checked.
notes: Roughly five MCP calls and one corpus query; well under the advisory budget.
